note: P8 (self-review of p7): upper arms turned in, arm twist = 0.85 x elbow flex on every key (negative, inward, on both arms), so the forward hand comes toward the thigh instead of flaring out. Everything else is p7. P7 POLISH (p3 + p4 rebuilt on p6, blocking rev 7): living hands and toe trail (p3); the roll carried into the early swing and faded by the passing, the roll easing negative into the strike, both re-solved so the world foot is stage a's on every key, and a planted copy of the foot 0.05 f inside each plant (p4). Rear heel peel and swing ankle as blocking rev 7.
